regime_context: Canada/TSX detector shows broad rotation (8 of 16 themes eligible) with Oil & Gas Producers a clear score leader and Gold Miners the only near challenger, but the rotation read is explicitly non-directional and one-narrative is false. Cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0, so this is a focus/drawdown-control lens only; the macro backdrop is AI/tech by a single recent item with 100% unscheduled share, offering no usable regime signal.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners (XGD.TO) closes the 0.502 score gap to Oil & Gas with improving breadth above 0.5 and durability above 0.5 — confirming a leadership handoff rather than a simple rank shuffle — before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is the trending leader with the highest score, strongest durability bar (0.68), eligible gate true, and best breadth (0.786), which together support a persistent trend continuation lean rather than a new-money chase. Crowding (z=1.04) is a size-down caution, not a fade trigger, and the validated absolute-trend gate argues this theme has the staying power to avoid a shake-out more than laggards.
evidence: breadth=0.786, strongest breadth in the set
theses.dissent: Crowding at z=1.04 with hurst_tag 'mixed' and r10 of only 0.0298 suggests recent momentum is already thin; energy leadership is reflexively fragile and the trend gate may simply be absorbing volatility without forward return.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags the S&P/TSX by more than 4% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: XGD.TO is the only realistic challenger to Oil & Gas, with score 1.11, eligible gate true, and moderate durability (0.48). It is not crowded and the margin between leader and challenger (0.502) is narrow enough that a confirmed handoff could occur, making a low-conviction overweight on gold a diversifying tilt toward the second-trending theme.
theses.dissent: Breadth is weak (0.267), hurst_tag is 'mixed', and rotation_timing is display-only with no validated forward edge — a challenger's rank is not a reason to expect a handoff; gold could simply sit below oil's trend.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO breaks below its own 20-day moving average and stays below it for 3 consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: XUT.TO is ineligible (score -0.115, below gate threshold), with low durability (0.37) and negative crowding (z=-0.78). The one validated edge is absolute-trend drawdown avoidance, and this theme has already failed that gate — an avoid lean is the direct consequence of respecting the trend discipline, not a prediction of further decline.
evidence: gate_helps=true (trend gate is the only validated edge)
theses.dissent: Utilities often act as a defensive counter-trend hold when energy leadership fades; negative crowding (z=-0.78) means no reflexive unwind risk and the theme could mean-revert upward rather than continue declining.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO closes above its 50-day moving average and holds it for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
